replication.target_description: Replication of Experiment 4 Part 1, Hypothesis 1: agency index in Sexual versus Clothed conditions, independent samples Welch t test, post-exclusion analysis. The supplied locators differ from the pagination/table numbering in the OSF preprint.

n.sample_role: Analytic participants by condition: Sexual = 321; Clothed = 315, after exclusions.
n.exclusions: 56 participants excluded across the full study under eight exclusion criteria; nine were excluded for correctly guessing the hypotheses. Target-condition sample sizes are explicitly printed in the post-exclusion table.

reported_success.quote: We conducted independent samples t-tests (Welch’s t, two-tailed) and found support for Hypothesis 1 that the agency index in Sexual Condition is lower than that of Clothed Condition

notes: Original title and authors verified in author-hosted full paper; source URL https://kurtgray-lab.squarespace.com/s/more-than-a-body.pdf . No printed d or contrast test statistic was found for the original LSD contrast; omnibus F and eta-squared are different tests and were not substituted. Replication title is Revisiting the link between Mind Perception and Objectification: Replication and Extension of Gray et al (2011), by Tsang and Feldman, obtained from assigned OSF file https://osf.io/download/7w5b6/ . Main-text pre-exclusion result (p. 31; Table 10 p. 42): Sexual N = 335, Clothed N = 338, t(666) = -5.20, p < .001, d = -0.40 [-0.56, -0.25]. Post-exclusion values retained consistently for replication n, es and p. Original g = -0.58 in replication comparison table is replication-author-derived and is not a printed effect size in the original target test.
